content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the telšiai district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property between two parties the defendant has been ordered to pay the applicant a compensation of eur 9065 the court has also divided the money received from the national paying agency and the ministry of agriculture equally between the parties the court has recognized certain personal properties of both parties and has ordered the defendant to compensate the applicant for the greater value of assets acquired during the marriage the court has also recognized the sale of a plot of land a tractor a car and livestock the applicant has submitted an amended application requesting the division of common property between the parties the defendant has submitted a counterclaim requesting the dissolution of the marriage and division of property the court has considered the evidence and expert reports provided by both parties and has made a decision on the division of property and compensation the court has upheld part of the counterclaim and has decided to dissolve the marriage due to fault on both sides the court has divided the property acquired during the marriage with one party receiving a residential house a warehouse a garage yard structures and two plots of land while the other party receives one plot of land the court has also divided the funds received from the national paying agency and ministry of agriculture with one party receiving a higher share and therefore being ordered to pay the other party compensation the court has recognized certain personal properties of both parties and has ordered one party to pay a stamp duty to the state the court has dismissed other parts of the application and counterclaim
